title: Who Truly Drives Sustainability? A Critical Review of Stakeholder Marketing Practices in Indonesia through a Systematic Bibliometric Review
core_idea: To integrate and synthesize existing practices and dynamics of stakeholder engagement in Indonesia's business and sustainability domains by conducting a systematic literature review guided by the PRISMA protocol.
tldr: A PRISMA-guided systematic bibliometric review that synthesizes stakeholder engagement practices and dynamics within Indonesia's business and sustainability contexts.
